list.item: Very high blood pressure at intake (178/104 and 174/102 mmHg) with morning headaches for two months, without signs of a hypertensive emergency; not previously diagnosed; ambulatory monitoring to confirm: active, confirmed [S]
Breathlessness on exertion for three months (walking to the school, carrying groceries) with mild ankle swelling by evening; cause to be determined: active, confirmed [S]
Food insecurity: food runs short at the end of most months (Hunger Vital Sign positive): active, confirmed [S]
Low and irregular income from substitute teaching and newspaper writing, with Original Medicare but no drug coverage; medicine costs a barrier: active, confirmed [S]

Respectful, shared decision-making: take her history as given, explain each test and medicine with its reasons and alternatives, write the plan down, and check costs with her before prescribing. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025) [S]

Cardiology consultation on the day of the two-week visit, with the echocardiogram, to confirm the cause of breathlessness, look for hypertensive heart disease and HFpEF and their mimics, and advise on treatment. Guideline: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure (2022); 2023 ACC Expert Consensus Decision Pathway on Management of Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction (2023); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and heart failure monographs (2026) [S]

Confirm the diagnosis with 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring today, before the first dose; then home readings twice daily with a validated upper-arm monitor and a large cuff lent by the clinic. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and heart failure monographs (2026) [S]

Start a two-drug combination for stage 2 hypertension: chlorthalidone 12.5 mg and amlodipine 5 mg every morning, from the morning after the ambulatory monitor is removed, as low-cost generics; target below 130/80 mmHg; less salt, using foods she already eats. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and heart failure monographs (2026) [S]

Baseline tests: ECG, NT-proBNP, metabolic panel and magnesium, hemoglobin, TSH, hemoglobin A1c, lipids, ALT and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio; echocardiogram because of raised NT-proBNP, breathlessness and suspected left ventricular hypertrophy. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension and heart failure monographs (2026) [S]

Stroke and emergency warning signs: BE FAST (balance, eyes, face, arm, speech, time to call 911), and call 911 for chest pain, severe headache with confusion or vision loss, or breathlessness at rest. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); Signs and Symptoms of Stroke (2026) [S]

Costs and coverage, with the clinic's community health worker: a SHINE counselor for Extra Help and the Medicare Savings Program; generic medicines in 90-day fills; patient assistance for any brand-only medicine until coverage begins. Guideline: Help with drug costs (Extra Help) (2026); Medicare Savings Programs (2026); SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders), Florida's State Health Insurance Assistance Program (2026) [S]

Food: the Hunger Vital Sign at intake; help applying for SNAP through ACCESS Florida; the food pantry list. Guideline: The Hunger Vital Sign (2026); SNAP Eligibility (2026); Public Assistance (ACCESS Florida: SNAP, Medicaid and Medicare Savings Programs) (2026) [S]
